pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygons with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Flank patches exhibit higher geometric complexity and fragmentation (stellate appearance) compared to the more consolidated, larger patches on the upper shoulder and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-section, maintaining a continuous negative-space graph across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane fibers creating a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck ridge against the background.
